scope.description: One FSM value implements both ConfigurationStore and BatchingFSM, and a committed LogConfiguration entry is applied through Raft's FSM batch path.
assumptions: The configuration entry is committed before the observation.
The combined FSM's ApplyBatch returns one response per received log entry.
excluded: FSMs that do not implement ConfigurationStore.
Application-level configuration recovery outside the Raft callback contract.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Uses the real BootstrapCluster, NewRaft, runFSM, and Barrier paths.
The single FSM value implements FSM, BatchingFSM, and ConfigurationStore so the batch branch is selected while the configuration-store callback is applicable.
The harness only counts LogConfiguration entries in ApplyBatch and invocations of StoreConfiguration; it does not replace protocol logic.

plan_uncertainties: The check uses the bootstrap configuration entry in a single-node cluster rather than every configuration-change command.
The check does not establish whether a particular application has an independent configuration-recovery mechanism outside ConfigurationStore.
grounding_unresolved: The observation covers the bootstrap configuration entry in one single-node cluster, not every configuration-change command or durable FSM implementation.
The check observes the bootstrap configuration entry in one single-node cluster; it does not enumerate every configuration-change command or every durable FSM implementation.
